016.title: Event conflicts that name what blocks them, awake-only events refused during sleep, calendar drag during a refresh
humanItems: The conflict messages read clearly and the `הצג` button helps fix the wrong entry.

notes.text: the folder baby-tasting-orch-tracker-3-016 was installed (root, scripts, server)

builder left undone (round 0): e2e 016-1: written, not run; e2e 016-2: written, not run; e2e 016-3: written, not run; e2e 016-4: written, not run; 003-2 / 008-1: not run, so I could not see what failed against the current app. I only made the locators stricter (exact label, first match) and kept every assertion. Please run them.
the folder baby-tasting-orch-merge-tracker-3 was installed (root, scripts, server)

decisions.text: behaviour: tapping הצג closes the open entry or edit sheet first, so any unsaved input is lost, then opens the blocking event in the edit sheet — reverse: drop the beforeShow callback passed to SaveErrorService.show in entry-sheet.ts
behaviour: the conflict line is a toast with a הצג action in sheets as well as quick actions, because the sheets show save errors as toasts today — reverse: render it inline in the sheet instead
behaviour: an awake event at exactly a sleep's start counts as inside it; at exactly its end it does not — reverse: change the comparison in server/domain/tracker/conflicts.js clash()
behaviour: the log page now hosts <app-edit-sheet /> so הצג works from quick actions there — reverse: remove it from log-page.html and log-page.ts

behaviour: an open sleep covers every later awake event, so starting or moving a sleep to a time before existing feeds is refused naming the feed (D-016-2) — reverse: skip awake events when the candidate sleep is open

seen: server/test/tracker-events.test.js — the server tests share one database, so an open sleep in the past conflicts with later fixture events; I changed those tests to use fresh timestamps and to delete what they create
